content:
Ivy (Partnerships): Heads up team  Avalanche Security signed a 3-year Dedicated capacity agreement + ISV listing on the Azure Marketplace. They're also starting a Private VPC trial for EU financial customers. Publishing comms next Wed morning. :tada:
Derek (Sales): Amazing news  congrats everyone. Who will draft the customer story and get the quote?
Nora (Marketing): I'll take the case study. Need: a 1-sentence quote (<=120 chars), a 2-sentence customer profile, and logo by EOD Mon so we can prep blog + press.
Sam (Solutions): Infra notes: dedicated pool in eu-west2 provisioned, model pinned to rwd-mistral-7b-quant, canary 5% -> 50% over 90m. Scheduled KV cache priming at 23:00 UTC. Enabling audit logs to their KMS.
Priya (Finance): Contract countersigned  3yr committed ARR = $1.35M. PO expected within 10 business days. Billing contact: procure@avalanche-sec.com.
ListBot: Azure Marketplace listing published: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/apps/avalanche-security-redwood (listing id: az-0xA7E). Propagation ~15-40 mins.
Derek (Sales): Avalanche legal ok'd this short quote: "Redwood combined low latency and enterprise isolation that we needed for our compliance needs." They also approved co-branded social. Assets to be uploaded in ~1h.
Nora (Marketing): Draft announcement uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/avalanche-launch.md. Requesting legal review, and a 30s CTO soundbite.
Sam (Solutions): I'll schedule the 20-min technical interview and capture the 30s clip. Perf smoke planned for 02:30 UTC; will post perf summary here. Checklist: warm KV, perf smoke, canary ramp, enable monitoring alerts.
Priya (Finance): Note: includes premium SLAs and advanced support. Please loop finance on any scope changes.
Derek (Sales): Shoutout to @Ivy and @Sam for the quick turnaround. Also adding CS to kickoff next week.
DeployBot: Onboarding ticket ONB-8810 created. SRE runbook attached.
Nora (Marketing): I'll queue social for Wed 9am CET after marketplace indexing. Coordinating cross-post with Avalanche comms team.
Ivy (Partnerships): Assigning owners: @Nora - case study + comms; @Sam - CTO clip + perf; @Priya - confirm PO and billing. Closing thread once indexing complete. Huge team effort! :rocket:
